title: cymba calyculata
intro: Cymba calyculata, commonly known as Cimicifuga, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to ease menstrual cramps, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Cymba calyculata include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
